hero.heading: For Golfers With a Goal.
hero.tagline: Raise support for your golf journey.
hero.intro: Whether you're competing, coaching, creating content or chasing your next golfing milestone, BuyMeATee helps your supporters become part of your journey.
hero.reassurance: Free to set up · Takes under a minute · Built for golfers

audienceGrid.heading: Every golfer has a goal.
audienceGrid.intro: Creator, competitor, coach or parent — BuyMeATee is where the people around your golf get behind it.

share.title: Set your goal
share.body: Create your page, tell your story and show exactly what you're working towards.

buy.title: Supporters get behind it
buy.body: They buy a tee, back a goal or fund a specific item — meaningful support, from a single tee to a green fee.

journey.title: You get there — together
journey.body: Share progress, milestones and updates so every supporter sees the goal getting closer.

featuredGolfers.heading: Follow a golfer's journey
featuredGolfers.intro: Every journey starts somewhere. Here's one golfer currently raising support on BuyMeATee.
featuredGolfers.previewNote: Shown as labelled Preview examples while the platform fills up — real goals appear here as creators publish them.

whySupporters.heading: People back people, not transactions.
whySupporters.intro: Supporters aren't buying anything — they're helping someone they believe in get somewhere they've promised to go.

partOfIt.title: Part of the journey
partOfIt.body: Back a golfer and a goal, then watch it happen — the progress, the setbacks, the milestones.

realGoals.title: Real goals, real progress
realGoals.body: Every contribution goes towards a visible goal with honest, live progress.

golfNative.title: Support that speaks golf
golfNative.body: Tees, holes, rounds and green fees — not coffees, not tips.

trust.title: Clear and secure
trust.body: The full breakdown is shown before anyone confirms, and payments run through Stripe's hosted checkout.

exampleGoals.heading: The journeys supporters get behind
exampleGoals.intro: Illustrations of the kind of goals golfers share — every card here is a labelled example.

pricing.heading: Simple, honest pricing.
pricing.intro: No subscriptions, no monthly costs — BuyMeATee only earns when your supporters back you.

free.title: Free to set up
free.body: Creating your page, sharing goals and posting updates costs nothing.

fees.title: One small fee per contribution
fees.body: BuyMeATee keeps a platform fee of {platformPercent}, plus payment handling of {paymentPercent} and a small fixed processing fee.

onTop.title: Creators receive the full gift
onTop.body: Fees are added on top of every contribution, not taken out of it — and supporters see the exact total before they confirm.
